meta_description: TMC Plastering and Building Services in Manchester. Expert plastering, rendering, and internal finishes. Call 07834 891135 for a free quote today.
hero_subhead: From patch repairs to full rewires, we deliver flawless finishes on time and on budget across Greater Manchester.
services_heading: Complete Plastering & Building Services Across Manchester
services_subhead: We handle everything from interior finishing to external rendering, new builds to renovations.

services.title: Internal Plastering
services.desc: Smooth, seamless walls and ceilings for your lounge, bedroom, or kitchen. We repair cracks, fill holes, and deliver professional finishes ready for decoration.

services.title: Skimming & Re-plastering
services.desc: Tired of bumpy, dated plaster? We strip and re-skim old surfaces, giving you a fresh, modern finish that transforms any room.

services.title: External Rendering
services.desc: Weatherproof, attractive render for your home's exterior. We use proven techniques and quality materials to protect your property and boost kerb appeal.

services.title: Drywall & Partition Walls
services.desc: Quick, clean stud work and drywall installation for new rooms, home offices, or open-plan restructuring. No mess, minimal disruption.

services.title: Artex Removal & Popcorn Ceiling
services.desc: Safe removal of dated textured ceilings and asbestos-free Artex, followed by professional re-plastering or drywall finish.

services.title: Patch Repairs & Cosmetic Work
services.desc: Single-day damage repair — cracks, water stains, impact marks. We match existing finishes so the work disappears into your walls.

about_pullquote: We treat every job like we're plastering our own home.
about_para_1: TMC Plastering and Building Services has been serving Manchester for over a decade. We started because we saw too many cowboys leaving messy, uneven work. From day one, we've focused on delivering crisp, professional finishes on domestic and small commercial projects. Our team carries all tools and materials — we turn up, get it done, and leave your home spotless.
about_para_2: We're known across Manchester for reliability, attention to detail, and honest pricing. Whether you need a single room skimmed or a full house renovation, we treat your project with the same care and pride. Repeat customers account for 60% of our work — that tells you everything about how we operate.
reviews_heading: What Manchester Homeowners Say About TMC

reviews.text: Had our lounge and hallway skimmed by TMC last month. Finish is absolutely immaculate — you'd never know it wasn't the original plaster. Lads were tidy, professional, and finished bang on schedule. Very competitive quote too. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: David M.

reviews.text: Nightmare Artex ceiling in our bedroom — looked like a 1980s nightmare. TMC came out, gave a fair quote, did the removal safely and re-plastered in one day. Looks brand new now. Can't fault them.
reviews.author: Emma R.

reviews.text: Used them for external rendering on a 1930s terrace. Tricky job, uneven old render underneath, but they sorted it perfectly. Been through two winters now with zero cracking or damp. Worth every penny.
reviews.author: Michael T.
